description: Header file defining the FrameRate plugin class, including nested Notification class, with methods for initialization, deinitialization, and event handling related to frame rate notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: FrameRate
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces, managing frame rate notifications and interactions.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class implementing connection and frame rate event notifications, used internally by FrameRate.

methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Information
